### `add_dependency`

**Add Dependency** · `POST /api/v2/task/{task_id}/dependency` · API v2 · 🟡 write

Set a task as waiting on or blocking another task.

| Argument | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `task_id` | path | string | yes | This is the task which is waiting on or blocking another task. |
| `custom_task_ids` | query | boolean |  | If you want to reference a task by it's custom task id, this value must be `true`. |
| `team_id` | query | number |  | When the `custom_task_ids` parameter is set to `true`, the Workspace ID must be provided using the `team_id` parameter. For example: `custom_task_ids=true&team_id=123`. |
| `body` | body | object | yes | JSON request body, fields below. |

### `add_task_link`

**Add Task Link** · `POST /api/v2/task/{task_id}/link/{links_to}` · API v2 · 🟡 write

This is the equivalent of the feature _Task Links_ in the right-hand sidebar of a Task.  It allows you to link two tasks together. General links or links to other objects than tasks are not supported.

| Argument | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `task_id` | path | string | yes | The task to initiate the link from. |
| `links_to` | path | string | yes | The task to link to. |
| `custom_task_ids` | query | boolean |  | If you want to reference a task by it's custom task id, this value must be `true`. |
| `team_id` | query | number |  | When the `custom_task_ids` parameter is set to `true`, the Workspace ID must be provided using the `team_id` parameter. For example: `custom_task_ids=true&team_id=123`. |
